prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot for GX1, Gabriel's private agency work dashboard. This is a DESIGN PREVIEW, no device mockup, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. Single flat full screen, wide 16:10 aspect ratio, ultra crisp legible Spanish text. Cohesive real product design, usable and buildable.

Shared design system across all screens: 220px wide deep navy #101c2b left sidebar, cool very pale blue-gray #f3f5f7 main working canvas, near-white surfaces, navy ink, fine cool-gray rules, precise modest 8px radii, cyan #22d3ee only for primary actions and selected states. Neutral Archivo-like sans serif typography, refined compact normal-case headings, 15-16px readable body; no oversized marketing headlines. Spacious but information-rich. Clean flat surfaces, subtle shadows only on overlays, no glow, no gradients, no sci-fi, no decorative charts, no KPI tile rows. Sidebar top simple typographic GX1 wordmark in white, small 'Espacio de trabajo'. Navigation 'Hoy', 'Clientes', 'Plan', 'Biblioteca' with small consistent line icons. Below navigation a 'Mis clientes' group with Ecopests, Caycer, RP Carpintería, GX1. Bottom avatar G and 'Gabriel' plus 'Ajustes'. Top utility bar across content: search field 'Buscar en GX1…', discreet outlined label 'Vista de ejemplo', and cyan '+ Capturar pendiente' button at right. Main page padding 36px. Real hierarchy, aligned columns, ample readable whitespace, coherent spacing and precise typographic rhythm. All task names and dates are synthetic demo data. Never display revenue, uptime, percentages, client avatars or invented logos. No public website marketing nav or footer.
Screen 1: Hoy — focus and daily continuity. Sidebar Hoy selected with a fine cyan left line and dark blue selected row. Header 'Hoy' and subtitle 'Jueves 12 de noviembre · Un paso a la vez.' Small 'Planear mi día' text action to the right.
Main area about 65% width left, 35% right. Left: title 'Mis prioridades' with small '3 elegidas'. One generous dark navy focused task panel, no other dark panel in content: upper label 'CAYCER · Contenido', headline 'Revisar guiones de la semana', status pill 'En curso', a horizontal rule, label 'Dónde te quedaste', sentence 'Listos los temas. Falta ajustar los cierres.', label 'Siguiente paso', sentence 'Revisar el guion 02 y definir su llamada a la acción.', bottom cyan 'Retomar tarea →' and subtle 'Ver proyecto'. Beneath this panel two simple white horizontal rows with unfilled task circles, client labels and concise tasks: ECOPESTS 'Probar el formulario de servicios' and GX1 'Definir el próximo contenido'. Distinguish a small 'Hoy' work-date label from no fabricated overdue.
Below priorities a flat list 'Agenda del día' with two items: 'Revisar avances de RP Carpintería' and 'Cerrar el día y dejar el siguiente paso', each a subtle outline action.
Right column 'Requiere atención' with thin dividers, restrained amber tiny indicator and clear text 'RP Carpintería' / 'Falta definir la siguiente acción' with 'Definir →'; next 'Ecopests' / 'Revisión pendiente' with 'Revisar →'.
Below a white capture inbox module 'Por organizar' small count '2', text input 'Escribe un pendiente…', two natural short notes 'Idea para video de GX1' and 'Revisar propuesta de seguimiento', each has small 'Organizar' action. Bottom of right column subtle 'Cierre del día' and 'Deja listo por dónde continuar mañana.' with outlined 'Registrar avance'.
Prioritize the focused task, make everything genuinely legible. Render complete screenshot.

Screen 2: Client/project continuity. Sidebar Clientes selected. Main region a meticulously aligned five-column workweek schedule occupying 78% width plus a 22% right backlog panel separated by vertical rule. Columns 'Lun 9', 'Mar 10', 'Mié 11', 'Jue 12', 'Vie 13'. Thursday header has cyan underline and a pale cyan background strip, not saturated. Calendar is day planning without hourly axes or fake capacity bars. Subtle row rules; breathable white task rectangles, concise titles, small client label and state. Monday completed 'CAYCER' 'Definir temas' small check; Tuesday 'ECOPESTS' 'Revisar flujo de servicios' small 'Hecho'; Wednesday 'RP CARPINTERÍA' 'Revisar avances del sistema' small 'En revisión'; Thursday two tasks 'CAYCER' 'Ajustar guiones' and 'GX1' 'Definir próximo contenido'; Friday 'CAYCER' 'Preparar grabación' small 'Entrega: 13 nov', and 'GX1' 'Revisión semanal' recurrence icon 'Rutina'. Every column small '+ Agregar' at bottom; leave meaningful empty space, avoid crammed tasks.
Right panel 'Sin programar' with explanatory line 'Elige un día para avanzar.' Two task rows 'Ecopests' 'Organizar materiales' and 'GX1' 'Revisar ideas pendientes', each has compact outlined 'Programar' action so drag isn't only control.
Below full schedule a slim white horizontal section 'Rutinas de la semana' with two rows: 'Revisión de clientes' / 'Viernes' / 'Pendiente'; 'Cierre de semana GX1' / 'Viernes' / 'Pendiente'. Bottom right outlined 'Revisar mi semana' button. No analytics, no progress percentages. Render complete screenshot.
